title: Berberine
body_html:
Berberine capsules offer a convenient and effective way to support your overall well-being with just 2 capsules a day. This formula is designed to help maintain normal blood sugar levels, promote heart health, and assist with weight management. Each capsule contains Granular Berberine Hydrochloride Extract, known for its ability to support normal metabolic functions and balance within the body.*


In addition to promoting normal blood sugar regulation, Berberine is widely recognized for its role in cardiovascular health. By supporting normal cholesterol levels and heart function, Berberine encourages a healthy heart and helps you maintain a balanced lifestyle. Whether you're looking to promote your heart health or simply manage your daily wellness, Berberine is a reliable option.*


For those looking to manage weight, Berberine is known for its potential role in supporting healthy metabolism and weight management. With regular use, this supplement helps keep you on track by promoting the body’s natural ability to maintain a balance, supporting your journey to better overall wellness.*


While Berberine offers valuable support for wellness, maintaining a healthy, active lifestyle with balanced nutrition and regular exercise is essential for achieving optimal health.


Ingredients: Granular Berberine Hydrochloride Extract 97% (bark) 10mg, Granular Berberine Hydrochloride Extract 8% (bark/root) 790mg, Cellulose (vegetable capsule), MCC (microcrystalline cellulose), L-Leucine, Olive Oil.

Manufacturer's country: USA

Product amount: 60 capsules

Gross weight (oz/lbs/g): 2.56 oz / 0.16 lbs / 73 g

Suggested use: As a dietary supplement, adults take two (2) capsules daily. For best results, take with 6-8 oz (177-236ml) of water or as directed by healthcare professional.

Warning: Do not exceed recommended dose. Pregnant or nursing mothers, children under the age of 18, and individuals with known medical conditions should consult a physician before using this or any dietary supplement. KEEP OUT OF THE REACH OF CHILDREN. DO NOT USE IF SAFETY SEAL IS DAMAGED OR MISSING. STORE IN A COOL, DRY PLACE.


*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.
